title: ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE SPECIAL ACT ON DECLARATIONS OF ABSENCE, ETC.
full_text:
ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE SPECIAL ACT ON DECLARATIONS OF ABSENCE, ETC.

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe the petition procedures, forms, etc. necessary for the enforcement of the Special Act on Declarations of Absence, etc. (hereinafter referred to as the "Act").

Article 2 (Issuance of Certificates of Persons Remaining in Unrecovered Areas)
(1) A person who wishes to obtain a certificate of a person remaining in an unrecovered area under Article 7 of the Act shall submit an application in the attached form (including an application in electronic-document form) to the provincial governor having jurisdiction over the place of the person's original family registry. <Amended on Mar. 17, 2004>
(2) A certificate concerning the family relationship registration records of the person remaining in an unrecovered area shall be attached to the application under paragraph (1). <Amended on Nov. 2, 2010>

ADDENDA <Presidential Decree No. 5317, Aug. 31, 1970>
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

ADDENDA <Presidential Decree No. 18312, Mar. 17, 2004>
(Decree Partially Amending the Regulations on Management of Parolees and Other Decrees for Electronic Processing of Civil Petitions)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

ADDENDA <Presidential Decree No. 19507, Jun. 12, 2006>
(Decree Partially Amending the Enforcement Decree of the State Claims Management Act and Other Decrees for Joint Use of Administrative Information and Reduction of Documents)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

ADDENDA <Presidential Decree No. 22151, May 4, 2010>
(Enforcement Decree of the Electronic Government Act)

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on May 5, 2010.

Articles 2 and 3
Omitted.

Article 4 (Amendment of Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) through (88) Omitted.
(89) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Special Act on Declarations of Absence, etc. shall be amended as follows:
In the main sentence of Article 2 (2), "Article 21 (1) of the Act on Promotion of Electronic Processing of Administrative Affairs, etc. for the Implementation of Electronic Government" shall be replaced with "Article 36 (1) of the Electronic Government Act".
(90) through (192) Omitted.

ADDENDA <Presidential Decree No. 22467, Nov. 2, 2010>
(Decree Partially Amending the Enforcement Decree of the Economic Education Support Act and Other Decrees for Joint Use of Administrative Information and Reduction of Documents)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
